description: Returns the list of existing Jamendo radios with their image, name and other metadata. Each radio can be streamed via the /radios/stream endpoint. Commercial "pro" radios require a commercial license and will only be returned if your account has that access.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the given field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction; default is ascending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' in the header indicating the total number of rows without limit/offset. Use sparingly for performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by a specific radio id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by radio type. 'www' are public, 'pro' are commercial and require a license.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by a unique radio name.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired radio image size in pixels.

responseFields.name: headers.warnings
responseFields.description: Any warnings returned by the API.

responseFields.name: headers.results_count
responseFields.description: Number of radio objects returned in this page.

notes: The endpoint path does not include the version prefix; version is implicit in the base URL.
"pro" radios are only returned for accounts with a commercial license.
The 'order' parameter accepts multiple values separated by commas, e.g., order=id_desc,name_asc.
The 'limit' parameter accepts the literal string 'all', but the API still caps the result set at 200 rows.
